candidates.name: Ovarian cystadenoma
support_spans: A 17-year-old nulliparous female presented with a two-year history of gradually progressive abdominal distension
The abdomen was markedly distended with a palpable mass rising approximately 3 cm above the umbilicus
Transvaginal ultrasound demonstrated an 18 cm diameter ovarian tumor
candidates.why: The patient's symptoms and imaging results suggest a large ovarian tumor, which is consistent with ovarian cystadenoma

candidates.name: Mucinous cystadenoma
support_spans: The lesion appeared unilocular with a 1.5 mm wall and no septations or solid components, and was suggestive of an ovarian origin
candidates.why: The imaging results describe a unilocular lesion with a thin wall, which is consistent with mucinous cystadenoma
